copy.headline: Eagles DB DeJean (concussion) exits win early at Cowboys
copy.caption:

DeJean went inside after being evaluated by the independent neurologist in the medical tent. He was replaced in the lineup by Michael Carter II.

story.title: Eagles DB DeJean (concussion) exits win early at Cowboys
story.summary: Eagles All-Pro defensive back Cooper DeJean was ruled out of Thursday's game against the Dallas Cowboys with a concussion. ARLINGTON, Texas -- Philadelphia Eagles All-Pro defensive back Cooper DeJean was ruled out of Thursday's 39-38 win at the Dallas Cowboys with a concussion. DeJean was injured on the first defensive series of the game on a third-down collision with running back Javonte Williams . DeJean went inside after being evaluated by the independent neurologist in the medical tent. He was replaced in the lineup by Michael Carter II . DeJean, 23, entered the game with an interception, six passes defensed and five tackles for loss on the season.
